PathForge-fit adaptation: ranking/search-content confidence demand was turned into an offline SERP snippet proof lab for comparing page promise, search intent, title/meta candidates, proof points, mismatch flags, and an exportable editor note without SEO APIs, search engines, hosted AI, remote fonts, CDNs, or external services.
V1 preserved and repaired only after static inspection found inline onclick attributes and dynamic innerHTML render paths around user-entered snippet/proof text.

Final static source scan passed before save: no inline event attributes, no forbidden dynamic HTML sink strings, no alert/confirm/prompt modal APIs, no document.write, no external http/https URLs, no CDN scripts/styles, and no remote fonts.
V3 preserved and repaired only after Chrome workflow verification found the Export Data button did not produce a download event or visible confirmation.

Final static source scan passed after prompt 4: no inline event attributes, no forbidden dynamic HTML sink strings, no alert/confirm/prompt modal APIs, no document.write, no external http/https URLs, no CDN scripts/styles, and no remote fonts.
Final inline script syntax check passed with node --check on the extracted script.

Chrome localhost workflow passed: rendered nonblank; filled page promise/search intent/title/meta fields; added second title/meta option and second proof point; hostile image-onerror title stayed literal with zero image nodes; editor notes generated correctly.
Copy Editor Notes passed: browser clipboard contained the generated EDITOR NOTES text and preserved the hostile-looking title as inert plain text.

Export Data showed visible success status text: Data exported successfully as content-proof-data.json. Chrome bridge did not surface a download event for the Blob click, so the verified handoff is the copy path plus visible export status.
Console warning/error check passed: no warn/error logs during workflow.

Viewport checks passed for intended responsive web layout: desktop document scrollWidth equaled clientWidth at 1405px; headless Chrome 390x900 screenshot rendered nonblank stacked form content without obvious clipping.

Importer dry-run passed with username NolanQuill and display name Nolan Quill; result mode source-run-intake, status queued, author /user/NolanQuill, and next step says no prompt/upvote page is created.

source_inspiration.outside_user_need: Large visible demand around SEO article and keyword strategy prompts signals marketers want confidence that search snippets, page promises, and content evidence line up before publishing.
source_inspiration.pathforge_fit_adaptation: The idea was altered into an offline Search Result Snippet Proof Lab with deterministic SERP-style card comparison, mismatch checks, and an exportable editor note instead of an SEO API wrapper, search scraper, AI rewrite service, or copied prompt.
source_inspiration.offline_reason: PathForge can serve and verify a committed static artifact with no remote dependencies, hosted generation, live search access, login state, or fragile external calls.
source_inspiration.no_copy_statement: No third-party prompt text was copied; source sites were used only as demand research.

steps.prompt_exact: I need a small offline snippet proof lab I can save and open for a content planning meeting: let me enter one page promise, search intent, a few title/meta options, and proof points, then compare SERP-style cards, flag mismatches, and export a clean editor note.
steps.response_summary: Initial offline content proof lab with SERP preview, proof points, editor notes, and JSON export, but it used inline handlers and dynamic HTML rendering.
